speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Make mine first. Judith will sing hers away down the current and then say it won.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three of them, one each, and the knife is your grandfather's, so lose it and you may explain the loss in the shop. The water here is a hand deep. That is the whole sea you get.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Mine is called after the ballad. She goes where the song goes.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I am not telling you the words. The song is hers, and the shallows can have them.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mine will not sail straight. You built it crooked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I built it in a hurry on the grass, which thou mayst call crooked if thou wilt. Give it a better start and less advice.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It did turn. It turned too far. The mast is an elder twig and the twig is heavier on one side.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then bite the heavy side. Mine is already at the arch.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: That is not the arch. That is a reed.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: A reed is an arch if you are small enough. Yours has gone in a circle.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It wants a deeper keel. Tell Father. He has the knife.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The knife has done three hulls and it is going back in my belt. A deeper keel would ground in a hand of water.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then she is a circle-boat, and a circle is a kind of winning if you are patient.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It is not winning. It is coming back to my hand, which is the start.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Leave the boats. I have got to the wall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it out, then. I am listening.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: There is a wall between their fathers' houses, and a crack in it, and they talk through the crack. Golding says the lovers found it. He does not say they looked for a door.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: A door is quicker. A crack is for people who like being unhappy.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I would be the wall. The wall has no lines to remember, and everybody needs it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Why did they not simply use the door?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I don't know. The book doesn't say.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You usually know, or you make a reason that sounds as if you had read further.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not for this. A crack is what the page gives them. That is all I have.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then mine is through. Crooked or not, she is at the arch now, the real one. Judith, yours is stuck in a reed.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: She is resting. Yours only goes straight by accident.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The pie will not have survived if we are late. You said toward the middle of the afternoon, Father, not the whole of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we go. Three boats, one race, and a question I would not answer. Pick them out of the reeds before the river keeps them. The knife comes back to me.
